title: IngestMessage
description: Canonical, versioned archetype every incoming payload must satisfy at the gate before it is published. Whatever passes this schema is guaranteed to at minimum fit the downstream process.

policyNumber.description: Business identifier. Fixed format so both emitter and receiver agree byte-for-byte.

amount.description: Monetary amount. Must be a JSON number, never a string.

channel.description: Origin channel. Closed enum: anything else is a deterministic reject.

name.description: Optional free-text name. Canonicalized to Unicode NFC at the gate.
